Definition of done:
- API keys are stored only as SHA-256 hashes plus `last4`. Tokens are `tly_` + 40 chars from crypto/rand, returned once on create and invite-accept, and absent from GET, snapshots and logs.
- Auth hashes the presented token. Revoked keys and removed members still get 401. Legacy plain-text snapshot tokens still load and are rewritten hashed on the next save. `last_used_at` is written at most once per minute per key.
- `go build ./...`, `go vet ./...` and `go test ./...` pass, with new tests covering format, hashing, legacy migration, the no-plaintext snapshot check, and the throttle.

## What changed

- **`internal/store/store.go`**: `createAPIKey` generates the token with rejection sampling over `[A-Za-z0-9]`, so there is no modulo bias. It stores `Hash` and `Last4`, and sets `Token` only on the returned copy. The lookup map is now `keysByHash`. `APIKeyByToken` hashes its input. `TouchAPIKey` skips writes within 60 seconds of the recorded use.
- **`internal/store/state.go`**: `FromState` hashes any legacy `token` it loads, sets `last4`, and clears the plain text.
- **`internal/store/types.go`**: `APIKey` gains `Hash` and `Last4`. `Token` is `omitempty`, so it never appears in stored or listed records.

Reviewed the diff against the task text and the stated definition of done. I found no correctness, security or requirement problems, so this is a SHIP.

What I checked:
- **Format and generation:** `newAPIKeyToken` uses `crypto/rand`, and the 248-byte rejection threshold is exact for a 62-character alphabet, so there is no modulo bias.
- **Plain-text exposure:** the only place the token leaves the store is the copy returned by `createAPIKey`, which `newCreatedAPIKey` puts in the create and invite-accept answers. The stored copy is written before `k.Token` is set, so `Export()` and snapshots never carry it. The listing goes through `viewAPIKey`, which drops both token and hash. The only logging change is the demo seed, which now logs the key ID and `last4`.
- **Auth:** `APIKeyByToken` hashes the presented token and looks it up by hash. The revoked-key and removed-member 401 paths in `authed` are unchanged.
- **Legacy migration:** `FromState` hashes any `token` it finds, sets `last4`, clears the plain text, and indexes by hash. `migrateV1` still decodes into `store.APIKey`, so v1 files take the same path. The next `Save` writes only `token_hash`.
- **Throttle:** `TouchAPIKey` returns early when the last use is under 60 seconds old, and always writes when there is no prior use.
- **Tests:** they cover format, hashing, legacy load, the no-plaintext snapshot check, the throttle and the one-time token, and they exercise the real v1 fixture.

Optional notes, not reasons to revise:
- The listing keeps `org_id`. It was already an existing field, and the task says to keep existing fields working, so keeping it is right.
- The demo seed no longer prints a usable key on first start. That follows from the once-only rule, and the README line was updated to match.
